about_the_game:
One day Felix wakes up and finds himself in an amazing place where the whole world is painted in blue and purple tones, called "Fiolexia", where, judging by some sign, we have to go to a bar and find out about some kind of white flag, and now your task is to bring it to the specified point.

Explore this whole unusual world, find secrets, interesting elements and many other things in them. Is there anything else you can find? - it depends only on you.

Features of the game:

  • The main story campaign for Felix;

  • Exploration of the overworld with its countries;

  • Random mini-games that appear during exploration of the overworld;

  • Dialogue with other characters, revealing details;

  • Combat system if an internal conflict occurs

Warning:

  • This game has some moments related to visual effects, vivid visuals, bright flash, some elements of horror and vocabulary, which may seem uncomfortable to some people. We recommend that you be vigilant sometimes so that nothing happens.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows XP, 7, 8, 8.1, 10, 11
  • Processor: 200 Mhz Pentium processor or higher
  • Memory: 1 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Must support minimum of Direct3D 9
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 100 MB available space

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, 11
  • Processor: 200 Mhz Pentium processor or higher
  • Memory: 2 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Must support minimum of Direct3D 9
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
